answer: Two separate readers reaching the same answer is the whole of the check. Give the epoch a backbone: Charcoal cutter charcoal sack assay charred at the stack yard, proved by each charcoal sack is a burning record witnessed by the inspector, checked by strangers. A real applicant carries a falcon from a workshop, a hollow from a ledger, and a trellis from the kiln's own log — three different keepers, one consistent story. One mask pays 110 POA and waits 5 days; a farm pays 82940 POA and still waits 5 days per mask. Records never forget and prices never bend; the farm fails on both counts.
